verdict.rationale: The QuickBooks Workforce API is documented, but its listed use cases are viewing employee information and managing deductions, payslips and pensions. Nothing shows creating an employee, setting compensation, or configuring tax setup through the API. The 'Hire and onboard in one professional flow' claim describes a UI product feature, and employees entering their own tax info is self-service, not programmatic onboarding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
